{"predictors": [
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Stability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of capital expenditures (from Compustat) over the past 5 years, normalized by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with stable capital expenditures are better positioned to generate consistent cash flows, as they are less likely to experience large swings in investment outlays", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry Relative Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of advertising expenses (from Compustat) to sales, then rank this ratio within each industry (defined by 2-digit SIC code) over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that efficiently allocate advertising expenditures within their industry are likely to experience higher growth and returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year moving average of the change in employee count (from Compustat), then calculate the acceleration of this growth rate over the past year", "rationale": "Firms experiencing accelerating employee growth are likely to be investing in high-growth opportunities, which can drive future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Trade Credit Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of accounts payable (from Compustat) to cost of goods sold, then normalize by the industry median ratio over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with high trade credit ratios are able to negotiate favorable payment terms with suppliers, indicating strong bargaining power and potential for higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Voluntary Disclosure Frequency", "construction": "Count the number of 8-K filings (from EDGAR) over the past year that are not required by law, then normalize by total assets", "rationale": "Firms that voluntarily disclose more information are likely to be more transparent and have lower information asymmetry, which can lead to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of sales concentrated among the top 5 customers (from Compustat), then normalize by total sales", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated supply chains are more vulnerable to customer-specific risks, which can lead to lower returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "R&D Tax Benefit", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of R&D tax credits (from Compustat) to total R&D expenses, then normalize by the industry median ratio over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms that effectively utilize R&D tax credits are likely to have a competitive advantage in innovation and investment, driving higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Investor Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of institutional ownership (from Thomson Financial) concentrated among the top 10 institutional investors, then normalize by total shares outstanding", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated institutional ownership are more likely to experience information-driven trading and potential price inefficiencies", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Marketing Expense Persistence", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year moving average of the change in marketing expenses (from Compustat), then calculate the persistence of this growth rate over the past year using an AR(1) model", "rationale": "Firms with persistent marketing expense growth are likely to experience stable and increasing brand value, driving higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Taxes Paid on Foreign Earnings", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of foreign earnings (from Compustat) to total earnings, then multiply by the effective tax rate on foreign earnings (estimated using a proprietary tax database)", "rationale": "Firms that minimize taxes on foreign earnings are likely to have a competitive advantage in global operations and investment, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
